_comment: When a tool with `triggers:` joins a prompt (it is never ranked). A trigger matches as a whole word or phrase, ignoring case and accents, so "split" is not found in "splitting.mp4". A trigger written in Chinese, Japanese or Korean script matches anywhere in the text: those languages write no spaces between words, so a word boundary never falls inside a sentence (the one-file-into-many tools:"把clip.mp4分割成每段10秒"). Python `knaif.registry.triggered`, Rust `knaif_core::registry::triggered`. A `#` in a trigger stands for a number ("every # pages" matches "every 10 pages"), so a phrase with a count needs no list of numbers.
